title: Puharich says his boss ran hypnosis and mind manipulation research
summary: Greg tells of Puharich says his boss ran hypnosis and mind manipulation research, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: says himself, I was involved in a program and my boss was the guy who did all research with hypnosis and mind manipulation.

plain: A researcher called Greg, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode links to the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, stated himself that he took part in a programme. According to Greg, Puharich said his boss there was the man who did all the research on hypnosis and mind manipulation, which if true would place Puharich inside government mind control work.
